title: Zesty Prawn Pasta Salad with Coriander-Lime Pesto
changes_from_base: A coriander, basil, walnut and lime pesto replaces the oregano vinaigrette, and prawns and cherry tomatoes replace the mozzarella and olives.
summary: Curly pasta coated in a bright green coriander, basil and lime pesto with walnuts and a hint of jalapeño, tossed with juicy prawns and cherry tomatoes.

ingredients.item: fine salt for 4 litres of pasta water (1%)
ingredients.note: about 6.75 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

ingredients.item: short curly pasta such as fusilli
fresh coriander, leaves and tender stems
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Blend the pesto
steps.text: Blitz the coriander, basil, walnuts, garlic, anchovies, jalapeño, lime zest and juice and salt to a rough paste, then pour in the oil with the motor running.

steps.title: Cook and cool the pasta
steps.text: Bring the water to a rolling boil and add the salt. Cook the pasta 1-2 min past al dente, then drain, rinse under cold running water until cool, and shake very dry.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Fold the pesto through the cold pasta, then add the prawns and tomatoes and toss gently.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Leave 15 min for the flavours to settle, taste for lime and salt, and serve.

tips: Cook the pasta a little past al dente; it firms up as it cools.
Pat the prawns dry so they do not water down the pesto.
Add the jalapeño seeds if you like more heat.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 1 day; loosen with a splash of water or oil and check the seasoning before serving. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
